book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.1:
Fertile Grounds

Richer soil, a shy Bean Fairy, and a home to keep one.

Lost this guide? Craft a new one from a Book and Bone Meal.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.2:
Enriched Soil

Craft Dirt or Sand with Bone Meal. Crops on Enriched Farmland or Sand have a 15% chance each growth tick to grow a stage. Add Glowstone Dust for Super Enriched soil: 50%.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.3:
Fertilizer

Use it on dirt or farmland to make it Super Enriched, or on sand to make Enriched Sand, without replanting. Dispensers can use it too.

Craft: Bone Meal, 2 Glowstone Dust, 6 flowers.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.4:
Bean Fairies

Some nights a Bean Fairy visits a farm and fully grows a 5x5 patch of crops.

To call one, use Fairy Dust (Glowstone Dust, Amethyst Shard, Bone Meal) on a crop. It comes that night.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.5:
Welcoming Fairies

Each kind of small flower within 8 blocks of your crops (up to 10 kinds) makes a visit more likely. So does a beehive or bee nest nearby.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.6:
Harvest Moon

On full-moon nights a Harvest Moon rises. Fairies visit three times as often, and their gifts are better.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.7:
Gifts

A visiting fairy sometimes leaves a gift by your crops. Bigger farms get better gifts. Each player can get one gift every 3 days, and gifts never despawn.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.8:
Catching a Fairy

After growing your crops, a fairy lingers for a minute. Sneak up (running scares it) and use a Glass Bottle on it.

A Jarred Fairy slips away after 3 days, leaving a flower.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.9:
Fairy Hotels

Craft an Empty Fairy Hotel: a Lantern, a Firefly Bush above it, and 7 flowers around. Use a Jarred Fairy on it within 3 days and the fairy stays for good. Break the hotel to move it.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.10:
Hotel Fairies

A hotel fairy grows crops within 4 blocks, adds honey to hives, speeds you up nearby, keeps creepers away, and stops trampling.

Brush the hotel once a day to make it happier.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.11:
Chime Hotel

Craft an occupied hotel with a Note Block and a Spyglass. When 80% of the crops within 8 blocks are grown, it rings a soft chime once. After the harvest it rings again.
book.fertilegrounds.guide.page.12:
Redstone

A comparator behind a Chime Hotel gives a 1-second pulse when it rings.

Comparators read soil too: 7 for Enriched, 15 for Super Enriched.
